Hero.title: We develop and automate the systems that grow your business.
Hero.description: Websites, applications, CRM, and automations — designed as one system, not as disconnected tools.

SystemProblem.title: Most companies waste time and money on processes nobody designed on purpose.
SystemProblem.description: Tools that don’t talk to each other, manual customer follow-up, information scattered across five places. It’s not a lack of technology — it’s a system problem.

ProblemSolutions.title: Problems we can help you solve
ProblemSolutions.description: We don’t start from a specific tool. First we understand what’s holding the business back, then we design the right solution.

repetitiveOps.body: We automate repetitive tasks so your team can focus on what requires judgment.

disconnectedSystems.body: We integrate your tools so operations work as one system.

messyCommercial.body: We organize commercial follow-up so no prospect gets lost.

ideasToValidate.body: We turn ideas into working products that can be tested in the market.

hardToUseInfo.body: We turn scattered data into dashboards people actually use to decide.

opsLimitedGrowth.body: We optimize processes and architecture so growth doesn’t multiply chaos.

ThinkingProcess.title: The solution starts before choosing the technology.

understand.title: Understand
understand.body: We grasp the business, the operations, and the real problem behind the symptom.

analyze.title: Analyze
analyze.body: We identify what depends on what, and where the real friction is.

design.title: Design
design.body: We define a simple, viable solution adapted to your context — not the most complex one.

build.title: Build
build.body: We develop and integrate every piece as part of the same system.

evolve.title: Evolve
evolve.body: We measure results and improve only when it adds real value.

Capabilities.title: What we can build together
Capabilities.description: Each project may need a different mix of development, automation, and integration.

automation.title: Automation
automation.body: CRM, commercial processes, internal flows, WhatsApp.

appliedAi.title: Applied AI
appliedAi.body: Process automation powered by artificial intelligence.

FoundersPreview.title: Two perspectives. One system.
FoundersPreview.description: Jera Labs is born from the union of development and digital operations.
FoundersPreview.bridge: Together we approach every project from three angles: business, experience, and technology.

alejandro.name: Alejandro
alejandro.body: Turns ideas and needs into functional products and interfaces: websites, apps, dashboards.

karla.name: Karla
karla.body: Connects tools, organizes commercial processes, and designs follow-up and operations systems.

JeraMeaning.title: Growth is also a system.
JeraMeaning.description: Jera is the Nordic rune of harvest and cycles: the result of a constant process, not a shortcut.
JeraMeaning.closing: That’s how we understand technology: solid foundations, continuous improvement, solutions that grow with the business.
